reasoning_content:
Now run the site install. The Development guide says:
`ddev drush site:install --yes --existing-config`

Let me run it in background.

action.command: su ddevuser -c 'cd /workspace && export PATH=$PATH:/usr/local/bin && nohup ddev drush site:install --yes --existing-config > /tmp/drush_si.log 2>&1 & echo "PID $!"'; sleep 30; tail -30 /tmp/drush_si.log

tool_call.name: terminal
